en.title: Saas-Fee snow forecast next week (23–29 November 2026): 22 cm at the top
en.description: Next week's fresh snow in Saas-Fee: 6–37 cm on the upper slopes and 5–30 cm at the base (23–29 November 2026), best day, best slopes and how sure the forecast is.
en.lede: The question for anyone heading to Saas-Fee next week is simple: how much, and where? Between Monday 23 and Sunday 29 November our forecast puts 22 cm on the upper slopes (6–37 cm), 21 cm around 2700 m and 18 cm at the base, with Thursday 26 November as the snowiest day.

sections.h: How the week of 23–29 November adds up in Saas-Fee
p: Read from the top down: 22 cm near 3600 m, 21 cm near 2700 m, 18 cm near 1800 m. The low-to-high spread is 6–37 cm at the top and 5–30 cm at the base.
Day by day, the upper mountain picks up most of it on Wednesday 25 (4 cm, up to 5), Thursday 26 (11 cm, up to 20) and Sunday 29 (3 cm, up to 5). Outside those days expect little more than flurries.
Low. At the top our forecast spans 6 to 37 cm: one version of the week brings a decent fall, the other almost nothing. Check again midweek before committing.
We will refresh these numbers every day; the resort page carries the latest version.

Thursday 26 November is the snowiest day up top: 11 cm in the middle of our forecast and up to 20 cm in the high case. The morning after a snowy day is usually the one to ski, once lifts and patrols have caught up.

Go high: depth is safest on the Allalin and the Fee glacier, and the best skiing should be on the glacier slopes above Felskinn. Treat the car-free village at the foot of the glacier as the weak point.

sections.h: Is Saas-Fee the best bet nearby?
p: At the top, next week, our forecast gives Zermatt (18 km away) 23 cm, Cervinia (28 km away) 23 cm and Verbier (50 km away) 24 cm, against 22 cm here.
Snow will not decide between these resorts next week. Height, aspect and which lifts are open will.

sections.h: Snow or rain at the bottom?
p: Little is lost on the way down: 18 cm around 1800 m against 22 cm up high. On these numbers the precipitation falls as snow almost everywhere in Saas-Fee.
Saas-Fee is ringed by summits above four thousand metres and its glacier is one of the earliest openers in Switzerland.

sections.h: This week in Saas-Fee: the set-up
p: The first instalment comes this week: 36 cm on the upper slopes of Saas-Fee from 17 to 20 November, 17 cm lower down. Next week adds a second layer on top.

advice: Before leaving the pistes in Saas-Fee, check the Swiss avalanche bulletin.
Opening dates are the resort's call; our numbers only say how much snow is coming.
Plan around the top's 22 cm, and keep the high case of 37 cm as a bonus.
